newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai soybean futures end mixed on uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai soybean futures end mixed on uncertainty.

text.p: Shanghai soybean futures ended mixed on Friday with investors holding widely different views on the short-term market trend, traders said.
The most actively traded September 1997 contract ended at an intra-day high of 3,396 yuan per tonne, rising 14 yuan. It opened at 3,390 and hit a low of 3,360.
May did not trade, July fell 51 to 3,331, November lost 15 to 3,360 and the January 1998 contract rose 40 to 3,405.
Combined volume rose to 23,200 tonnes from 19,000.
Soybeans opened mixed and moved in a narrow range for most of the session, traders said.
